items.caption: In this seal-script rendering, 西 has a rounded upper enclosure with crossing strokes inside and a long descending stroke at the right. The form illustrates the later seal-script tradition; its shape alone does not establish the graph’s disputed origin.
items.alt: Black seal-script form of 西 on a white background, with an enclosed set of crossing strokes and a long right-hand descending stroke.
items.selection_reason: This candidate is identified as 西 in Shuowen seal-script style and provides a useful later-form reference. The broader graphic-history source labels small-seal as one stage, while the graph’s proposed nest origin and route to the meaning “west” remain unsettled.

limitations.text: The image is a modern vector reconstruction of a seal-script form, not a dated artifact. The available evidence does not establish a precise date for this form or resolve whether 西 began as a nest image, was borrowed for “west,” developed that sense through a sunset association, or reflects another proposal.
